rung_purposes.purpose: Initialize test parameters (fill threshold, max pressure drop, and overpressure limit).
Detect pack pressure transmitter wire break / out-of-range low fault (D100 < -500).
Latch overpressure fault M291 when pack pressure exceeds limit D123.
Latch low supply air pressure fault M293 if supply switch X22 drops while busy.
Reset fill timeout, overpressure, and supply air faults on reset PB X1.
Consolidate alarm conditions and E-stop status into master trip M299 and beacon Y25.
Energize vent valve Y22 via manual vent pushbutton X25 when not in auto mode.
Initiate test cycle on pallet arrival in auto with no fault; clear results and set CLAMP.
Advance from CLAMP to FILL step when clamp closed switch X20 confirms clamp engagement.
Run 8.0s fill phase timeout timer T21 during FILL step.
Latch fill timeout alarm M290 when fill timer T21 expires.
Advance from FILL to STABILISE step once pack pressure reaches threshold D122.
Run 5.0s pressure stabilisation timer T22 during STABILISE step.
Sample initial test pressure into D110 when test window timer contact T23 is ON.
Advance from STABILISE to TEST step when stabilisation timer T22 completes.
Run 10.0s pressure decay test window timer T23 during TEST step.
Sample final pressure into D111 on T23 done and calculate pressure drop into D112.
Evaluate pressure drop D112 against limit D120 to set PASS (M210) or FAIL (M211).
Advance from TEST to VENT step when test window timer T23 completes.
Abort active cycle on master fault M299, set FAIL result, and jump to VENT step.
Run vent timer T200 during VENT step.
Advance from VENT to UNCLAMP step when vented (T200 done, D100 < 1.00 kPa, sensor OK).
Advance from UNCLAMP to COMPLETE step when clamp open switch confirms retracted.
Reset COMPLETE step and cycle busy flag M200 once pallet departs test position.
Energize clamp solenoid Y20 during CLAMP, FILL, STABILISE, TEST, and VENT steps.
Energize fill valve Y21 during FILL step if master fault M299 is clear.
Energize vent valve Y22 during VENT step or on overpressure fault M291.
Output PASS (Y23) or FAIL (Y24) signal to line controller during COMPLETE step.
End of main program scan.
